title: CIL Commons — long-answer panel 1 (spec 418): eight single-skill requests whose answers are long documents, for a side-by-side of the default answer model against a stronger one (kept small on purpose)

replay.title: CIL Commons — long-answer panel 1 (spec 418): eight single-skill requests whose answers are long documents, for a side-by-side of the default answer model against a stronger one (kept small on purpose)

intents.message: Build the pack for next Tuesday's trustee meeting: approve the audit, vote on renewing the lease, and the treasurer's conflict declaration on the IT contract.
We run an eligibility chatbot and a case-note summarizer. Write our AI incident response playbook, with severity levels and disclosure steps.
We use AI for donor emails, intake triage and grant summaries across 40 staff. Assess our AI governance maturity and give us a roadmap.
Draft a full proposal to the Maple Trust for $75,000 over two years for our reentry mentoring program, due July 1; mark every claim we still need to verify.
Write a decision brief on merging with Eastside Family Services versus a shared-services partnership, with the evidence for each option.
Our youth orchestra program wants independence: compare a fiscal sponsor, a supporting organization, and its own 501(c)(3), and list questions for counsel.
Our grantee, a twelve-person legal aid clinic, uses an AI intake screener. Score their responsible-AI practices at the right capacity tier and name the support we should fund.
We're evaluating an AI case-management add-on that reads client files. Give us the full vendor checklist, red flags and a go/no-go framework.
